changes.before: Friskoli 将细胞表面酶展示与趋化富集结合，增强菌体与固体底物的局部接触和传质，为太空生物反应器提供模块化工艺改良。纤维素用于展示这一路线，平台的作用范围由局部接触机制决定。
changes.after: 以菌体表面展示的酶在固体底物接触处开展催化，结合对可溶性降解产物的趋化响应，使细胞向底物附近富集。该模块将局部降解、定向运动和细胞接触相衔接，用于改善反应区域的物质传递。

changes.before: Friskoli combines cell-surface enzyme display and chemotactic enrichment to improve local cell–solid-substrate contact and mass transfer as a modular contribution to space bioreactors. Cellulose illustrates the route; the platform is centered on the contact mechanism.
changes.after: Enzymes displayed on the cell surface catalyze reactions at the solid-substrate interface, while chemotactic responses to soluble degradation products draw cells toward the substrate. The module couples local degradation, directed movement and cell contact to improve mass transfer within the reaction region.
